EvalAssertion.description:
One check on the evaluated document `{"output": ..., "intents": [...]}` (the output
without its reserved `intents`, and the raw intents), at `pointer`.

equals.description: The value there, exactly (canonical JSON equality).
equals.title: Equals

length.description: The length of the string, array or object there.
length.title: Length

contains.description: A substring of the string there, or an element of the array there.
contains.title: Contains

EvalAssertion.title: EvalAssertion

EvalExpect.description:
What a case expects. Everything is optional: an empty `expect` only asks for a
schema-valid output whose intents the guard accepts.

schema_valid.description: Whether the output passes the skill's full output schema (`validate_output`).
schema_valid.title: Schema Valid

output.description:
The exact output, without its reserved `intents` (canonical JSON equality). Absent:
not compared.
output.title: Output

intents.description: The exact raw intents, as the model proposed them (before any target is filled).
intents.title: Intents

intent_counts.description: How many intents of each type (a type not listed: none).
intent_counts.title: Intent Counts

guard.description:
Whether the action guard accepts the intents (decision 46); `violation` for a case that
proves a hostile output is refused.
guard.title: Guard
